- It's automated — no human intervention needed
- It's scalable — you can run thousands of attempts per minute

- Password managers generate and store unique passwords for each site
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA) adds another layer of verification
- Rate limiting prevents automated attacks
- Password policies require complexity requirements
